item.description: From celebrating the late Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani’s legacy in women’s reform to the Netherlands turning manure into a hot commodity, plus a win for American democracy and puffy new planets in the Milky Way, today’s news is full of progress and surprises!
